message: Function has too many control/statement nodes — consider splitting

evaluator_config.message_template: Function '{name}' has {count} control/statement nodes (max 300) — consider splitting into smaller functions

rationale: Functions with extreme statement density are hard to test and maintain. Threshold of 300 control/statement nodes is set for universal application including declarative interpreters and large match/dispatch functions. Dunders and properties are out of scope.
remediation: Extract distinct responsibilities into separate, well-named functions.
